title: After the Tenno Sho (Autumn): Overlapping Dreams

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin crosses the finish line in the autumn Tenno Sho alongside the dreams of many, with a smile of pure joy on her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her doubts are gone. She's going to keep enjoying running for herself. And I bet she'll turn all those cheers into her driving force.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that in mind, I decide to make our next race the one she'll enjoy most.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're taking on the Japan Cup, a race in which runners from around the globe compete. And knowing Ines, I'm confident she'll be able to enjoy herself more than anyone in the world!
